Author: Sharad Kumar Sharma
Bench: Sharad Kumar Sharma

S No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  18.08.2023 C482 No. 1499 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Mohit Kumar, Advocate, for the applicants.
Mr. V.K. Gemini, Deputy Advocate General, for the State.
Km. Meenu, Advocate, for the respondent.

The parties to the instant C482 Application had participated in the proceedings through video conferencing and they had been duly identified by their respective counsels, particularly, this Court has interacted with the complainant respondent No. 2 herein, who had dated 22.05.2019, as against the present applicants for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

The C482 Application is accompanied with the Compounding Application (IA/1/2023), contending thereof that the parties have agreed that the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 6270 of 2019, State Vs. Nazim Qureshi & others, which is presently pending consideration before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar, may be dropped and the basis for quashing of the proceedings is on the ground that they have filed a settlement deed before the Court dealing with the proceedings under Section 125 and based on which the proceedings under Section 125, as drawn by respondent No. 2 has already been dropped.
The learned counsel for the applicant, as well as, the respondent submit that in the light of para 4 and 6 of the said settlement dated 04.03.2020, the parties have agreed that they would not initiate any proceedings against one another relating to the matrimonial dispute.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Further, it has been observed that any pending proceedings would not be pursued by them.

As far as the contents of the compromise deed dated 04.03.2020 is concerned, the same has been accepted by the complainant respondent No. 2, with whom this Court has interacted and she has made a statement before this Court that the said settlement may also be read for the purposes of composition of the offences for which the applicants have been summoned.
C482/1499/2023 on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172515577/
1
The learned Government Advocate was called upon to argue the matter.

He submits that since it is a matrimonial dispute, coupled with the fact that since the parties have settled their dispute in terms of the compromise, he would be having no serious objection if the Compounding Application is allowed and the aforesaid criminal proceedings are dropped.

Owing to the fact that the complainant respondent No. 2 is agreeable to the terms of the settlement deed dated 04.03.2020, based on which she has already proceeded to withdraw the proceedings under Section 125.
She has further made a statement that the instant C482 Application may also be allowed in terms of the compounding application.

Owing to the aforesaid statement, coupled with the fact that the parties have already opened themselves to file a Suit for dissolution of marriage, this C482 Application would stand dropped and as a consequence thereto, the further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 6270 of 2019, State Vs.
Nazim Qureshi & others, pending consideration before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar would hereby stand quashed.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 18.08.2023 Mahinder/
